definitions.abstraction: Spreading is a common process underlying Atlantic enlargement and Red Sea formation.
negatives: All ocean basins formed by the same spreading process.

definitions.abstraction: Opposing vertical movements of warm and cool air participate in creating an air current.
negatives: Every meeting of warm and cold air produces an equally powerful jet stream.
The evidence supplies neither every-meeting scope nor equal power.
An airplane gets a jet-stream boost regardless of its travel direction.
The boost is conditional on traveling in the same direction.
The cooler air rises while the warmer air sinks to replace it.
The warm and cool referents have been exchanged.
Jet streams average about 110 kilometers per hour.
The source specifies miles per hour.
definitions.paraphrase: Jet streams arise where warm air meets cold air in the atmosphere.
definitions.synthesis: When warm and cool air meet, warm air rises and cool air sinks to replace it.
definitions.uncertain: The next jet stream over this location will move at 110 miles per hour.

definitions.abstraction: Committee review can gather views and revise proposed legislation before reporting it to the chamber.
negatives: Committee review guarantees that each reported bill has bipartisan support.
Every introduced bill is referred to exactly one committee.
Typically and committee or committees have both been lost.
A committee chair selects formal attention over a four-year Congress.
The frozen source specifies a two-year Congress.
A committee reports a bill before considering any amendments at markup.
The frozen account describes reporting with changes adopted in markup, not this inverted order.
definitions.paraphrase: Introduced bills are usually referred to the chamber's committees with relevant jurisdiction.
definitions.synthesis: Committee review may include hearings, and markup includes votes on proposed amendments before reporting with adopted changes.
definitions.uncertain: The next introduced bill will be reported by its committee.

definitions.abstraction: Orbital dependence helps distinguish the source's categories: moons require a planet to orbit, and planets require a star to orbit.
negatives: Every nebula forms a solar system identical to ours.
Ingredients for formation do not guarantee identical outcomes.
A nearby star's explosion definitely triggered formation of our solar system.
The source says currently think and perhaps.

The defining orbit target is a planet.
Earth is not a world known to have life.

definitions.synthesis: The solar system formed from gas and dust; such clouds contain ingredients for stars and planets.
definitions.uncertain: There is no life anywhere outside Earth.

definitions.abstraction: Scale is a measurement boundary: watershed process indicators exist, but their national-scale development remains a research challenge.
negatives: Remote sensing directly measures every ecological process at national scale.
Snapshots and inference do not establish universal direct measurement.
Repeated measures over a season always provide an indicator of net primary production.

Indicators for selected processes do not project to every service or direct measurement.
definitions.paraphrase: Biological, physical and chemical processes sustain ecological systems.
definitions.synthesis: Ecological processes sustain systems and provide resources and air/water-quality regulation, yet direct national-scale measurement is difficult.
definitions.uncertain: A national decomposition indicator will be available next year.

definitions.abstraction: Linking atomic arrangements to properties supplies a basis for designing materials with desired properties.
negatives: The atomic arrangement alone completely determines every material property.
Correlations and design relevance do not prove complete determination.
The observed atomic defects caused the measured magnetic properties.
The frozen research account reports correlation, not this causal finding.
The atomic positions were measured with 22 nanometer precision.
Scientists mapped 16,627 iron atoms and 6,569 platinum atoms.
The two element counts are exchanged.
definitions.paraphrase: Atomic structural order and defects were associated with magnetic properties at the level of individual atoms.
definitions.synthesis: Scientists mapped more than 23,000 atomic positions with 22 picometer precision and correlated structural order and defects with magnetic properties.
definitions.uncertain: The measured defects are the sole cause of magnetic behavior in every nanoparticle.

definitions.abstraction: Recurring bottleneck delay is a joint-condition phenomenon: design deficiency and traffic overburden are both required in the source's account.
negatives: Every delay anywhere on a corridor is caused by a bottleneck at one location.
Local bottleneck scope cannot be widened to all delay.
At a recurring bottleneck, deficient design alone suffices for delay regardless of demand.
The source expressly requires both deficiency and overburden.
FHWA attributes 45 percent of congestion to bottlenecks alone.
45 percent is the combined figure, not the bottleneck-only figure.
invalid relation projection due to changed scope
All road design causes pervasive corridor congestion even without traffic overburden.
The endpoint and conditional scope of the physical bottleneck relation have changed.
definitions.paraphrase: A roadway need not become narrower for a bottleneck to occur.
definitions.synthesis: FHWA attributes 40 percent of nationwide congestion to bottlenecks and another 5 percent to poor signal timing; together these are said to account for 45 percent.
definitions.uncertain: Removing this bottleneck will reduce next year's nationwide congestion by exactly 40 percent.

definitions.abstraction: Measurement uncertainty is a way to characterize limited knowledge, not a claim that a single reported value is certainly exact.
negatives: Any uncertainty interval guarantees that the true value is its midpoint.
No midpoint guarantee follows from interval or distribution language.
For every measurand, uncertainty must be a standard deviation.
The source's scalar example admits alternatives; it is not a universal must.
The International Prototype Kilogram has mass 1 gram.
Instrument indications are meaningful relative to a standard even without calibration.
The frozen sufficient condition is calibration; it does not establish the uncalibrated claim.
definitions.paraphrase: Measurement uncertainty reflects incomplete knowledge of the quantity being measured.
definitions.synthesis: Uncertainty expresses incomplete knowledge of a measurand, and a distribution over its possible values represents that knowledge state.
definitions.uncertain: This unreported instrument has uncertainty exactly 0.01 kg.

text-70e7e3d20325dd5d:claim-1:0.quote: Ecological systems are sustained by a number of biological, physical, and chemical processes, including primary production (conversion of the sun's energy into organic matter through photosynthesis), and the associated cycling of carbon, nutrients (nitrogen, phosphorus), hydrogen/oxygen, and other elements from the physical environment (air, water, land) through biological organisms and back into the physical environment.

text-70e7e3d20325dd5d:claim-2:0.quote: They also play an important role in providing ecological services—for example, providing natural resources, such as food, fiber, and timber, and regulating air and water quality.

text-70e7e3d20325dd5d:claim-3:0.quote: Only one indicator that meets the ROE criteria, Carbon Storage in Forests, is available to address this question because ecological processes are difficult to measure directly, particularly at a national scale.

text-70e7e3d20325dd5d:claim-4:0.quote: For example, remote sensing imagery has been used to obtain "snapshots" of indicators of ecosystem conditions over time, and to infer ecological processes such as terrestrial net primary production.

text-70e7e3d20325dd5d:claim-5:0.quote: Repeated measures over a season might provide an indicator of net primary production.

text-70e7e3d20325dd5d:claim-6:0.quote: Indicators for other ecological processes, such as respiration, nutrient cycling, or decomposition have been developed for ecosystems at watershed scales, but have not been developed at the national scale.

text-70e7e3d20325dd5d:claim-7:0.quote: Developing these indicators at the national scale represents a significant scientific and research challenge.
